lines.text: Many learners say: He don't like tea.
With he or she, use doesn't.

data.why: With he or she, use doesn't.

native.tip: 主语是 he、she、it 时，否定要用 “doesn't”。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He don't like tea.”？😅 主语是第三人称单数时，否定要用 doesn't：“He doesn't like tea.”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“doesn't”。主语是 he/she/it 要用 doesn't！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: With he, she or it, the negative is “doesn't”.
en.caption: Do you say “He don't like tea.”? 😅 With he, she or it as the subject, the negative is doesn't: “He doesn't like tea.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
